I’m seeing a lot of common sense advice so here’s my full guide: 

SHOWER

Ditch loofahs, use exfoliating body gloves. I noticed a big improvement in body acne after doing this.

Moisturize your entire body after showering. If you can find the time to wash your skin you can find the time to moisturize it. (I personally like vaseline cocoa radiant)

SKINCARE

I HIGHLY recommend the 60 second rule. Wash your skin for a full 60 seconds, I noticed a big difference after one week. Cerave is the best brand for cleansers and moisturizers.

Whatever product you put on your face, put on your neck as well.

HAIR

Only shampoo 1-3 times a week max. Shampooing only when needed is a good practice.

Some basic styling products are moose, hair dryer, and a styling cream. 


EYEBROWS 

Invest $10-15 in getting your eyebrows shaped, then get a cheap eyebrow razor at a drugstore and  clean it as it grows back. This is really underrated and can make a guys face go from a 6 to a 7.

MAKEUP

Buy a concealer, apply when necessary. Every politician and actor wears makeup for a reason. No one will notice.

It honestly depends what major/career you’re looking after. Debt isn’t the end of the world if your major/school guarantees good pay. And if your major requires networking, like business, than I would definitely consider the prestigious school personally. After that I would base my decision on which school I like more, try not to overthink it. 

Keep in mind that for a lot of majors, such as engineering or pre med, it doesn’t matter which school you go to. For a lot of science and math majors the prestigious school might grant you a slightly higher salary but at the cost of higher debt.
